svg.text: cove-edge: where each request ran, parked and resumed
313 requests · 4 workers · 28 parked at most at once · 134 of 182 resumes on a different worker (74%) · 13 timeouts · latency p50 0.1 ms, p99 342.0 ms
Worker threads: a bar wherever one is running a tenant's isolate
Requests, in arrival order: bar = running, thin line = parked, grey = waiting for a worker
Runs shorter than 1.5 px are drawn 1.5 px wide; hover (in the HTML) or the table gives exact times.
